EVIDENCE_SPAN_REMOVED_OR_EXTERNALIZED_FI.reason: Review applies to exact artifact hashes, independently of semantic support.
Knowledge handling policy, not evidence text.
Derived retrieval eligibility; no new retrieval implementation.
Source authority assessment may inform a judgment; source authority alone is not support.
Interpretation is separated from the verbatim excerpt.
An interpretation is an independently judgeable statement.
Support is assessed against an exact proposition.

span_constraints: Exact text is immutable; content_hash is SHA256 of its exact UTF-8 bytes, with no whitespace normalization.
Artifact hash is resolved through source_artifact_id and verified against acquired bytes; do not confuse text digest and artifact digest.
Artifact and span must identify the same SourceRevision.
Locator required; page optional except a pdf_page locator requires page>=1.
Offsets occur as a pair, start>=0 and end>start, in the named immutable Unicode text stream; raw PDF byte offsets are not text offsets.
New source revision creates a new span even if text is identical; old source edition is not automatically unsupported.

assessment.confidence_rule: If supplied, finite number within [0,1]; no automatic trust threshold.
assessment.direct_support_rule: DIRECT_SUPPORT requires subject/predicate/object aligned and scope_alignment=aligned; completed is not reviewed/trusted.
assessment.refutation_rule: REFUTES requires aligned subject/predicate/object and aligned scope; broader/different scope can at most be conflicting or uncertain.

support_types.definition: Exact evidence entails the statement's subject, predicate, object, and compatible scope.
Evidence supports a proper subset of the statement or a narrower scope.
Evidence supplies relevant context but does not entail the assertion alone.
Evidence presents an incompatible assertion without establishing formal refutation.
Evidence directly establishes the negation or invalidity of the assertion under the same scope.
Evidence is topically related but supplies no support for the assertion.
Support cannot be determined without additional evidence or review.

multiple_evidence: One StatementRevision can have many independent assessments and spans; contradictory and supporting assessments coexist, without majority-vote collapse.
independence: Group by SourceWork and derivation lineage; preprint/journal/mirrors or repeated spans are not automatically independent. Distinct work IDs also do not prove independence. Missing independence data stays unknown.
